question: What geometric figures should be drawn in the middle of the kuṇḍa after the lines?
premises: three lines are drawn in the heart
upper lines correspond to brahma vaivasvata indra
circle and earth-house are drawn in kuṇḍa middle
inference: The rite prescribes adding a circle and earth-house to the kuṇḍa after line construction.
uncertainties: exact ritual referent of kṣitigṛha is uncertain
whether likhet is imperative or optative
plain_english: Then in the middle of the kuṇḍa one should draw a circle and an earth-house.
